frequency_question: How often do announced major central industrial/EV schemes successfully issue formal gazette notifications meeting all specific criteria (e.g., interest subsidies and credit guarantees) within their target windows?
membership_rule: Members are centrally announced industrial or automotive financial incentive schemes (such as FAME phases, PLI sub-schemes, or heavy vehicle transition funds); excluded are minor state-level schemes or general policy guidelines without financial mechanisms.
